name: Lightbox
hint: Open an image, then pinch, scroll or double-click to zoom. Drag down to close.
description: Thumbnail grid that opens your images in a full-screen viewer: each image grows from its thumbnail and shrinks back, zooms toward the pointer with pinch, wheel or double-click, pans when zoomed, swipes between images and drags down to close. Takes items with sizes so nothing jumps, a controlled index and open state, loading and broken-image states.
usage: Use for portfolios, product photos and galleries. Pass `items` as [{ id, src, alt, thumbnail, title, caption, width, height }]; give width and height (or any pair with the image's aspect ratio) so the viewer doesn't resize when the image arrives, and a small `thumbnail` so the grid doesn't download full images. Track the open image with `index` / `onIndexChange` and the viewer with `open` / `onOpenChange`. To open it from your own thumbnails, pass `showGrid={false}` and set `index` and `open` in their onClick: it grows from the clicked element and focus returns to it. Keep captions short.

dataProps.description: [{ id, src, alt, thumbnail, title, caption, width, height, art }]. src is the full image (fetched only when shown, plus the next one); thumbnail the grid image (else src, lazily); alt names it; title and caption show under the viewer; width / height give the aspect ratio before it loads (else 4:3 until it does). Empty by default. `art` is for work drawn in code: an Art description from `components/_shared/art.jsx`, shown in place of `src` in the grid and the viewer.
